in_text_mentions: Ultrasound showed intra- and extrahepatic bile duct dilatation (CBD: 15.8 mm), the absence of gallbladder consistent with prior cholecystectomy, and a starry sky pattern. Doppler ultrasound demonstrated the intrapancreatic portion of the CBD and its vascular relations (Figure 1), followed by a confirmatory image with biliary catheter in situ (Figure 2).
